| Class | Match? | Reason |

| Spider_Mites | Weak | Bronzing/stippling on green leaves — not widespread yellow |
| Leaf_Mold | Weak | Patchy pale lesions, not uniform widespread chlorosis |
| Early_Blight | No | Distinct concentric target rings |
| Late_Blight | No | Large grayish-brown necrotic patches |
| Powdery_Mildew | No | White powdery coating |
| Mosaic/TMV | No | Mottled green pattern, no yellowing |
| Target_Spot | No | Mostly green with defined small spots |
| Bacterial_Spot | No | Small lesions with halos on predominantly green leaf |

**Conclusion:** The test image best matches **Septoria_Leaf_Spot** — the top-left reference panel shows a nearly identical pattern: a severely yellowed leaf with small dark spots scattered throughout, on the same gray background. This represents advanced Septoria infection where yellow halos around individual lesions have merged into widespread chlorosis.
